cards.ex: She's usually very level-headed, even in a crisis.
cards.exUz: U odatda juda xotirjam, hatto inqirozda ham.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatlarda xotirjam va aql bilan ish ko'radigan odam.

cards.ex: She's a sharp cookie; she figured out the problem immediately.
cards.exUz: U juda aqlli; u muammoni darhol hal qildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda aqlli va ziyrak odam.

cards.ex: She showed a lot of backbone in standing up to her boss.
cards.exUz: U boshlig'iga qarshi turishda katta qat'iyat ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Qat'iyatlilik, mustahkam xarakter va prinsipiallik.

cards.ex: He's a real go-getter, always looking for new opportunities.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy intiluvchan, doimo yangi imkoniyatlar qidiradi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun faol harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: Despite the setbacks, she never gave up on her dream.
cards.exUz: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, u hech qachon orzusidan voz kechmadi.
cards.uzDef: Muammolar, to'siqlar, muvaffaqiyatsizliklar.

cards.ex: Don't be such a wet blanket; let's have some fun!
cards.exUz: Bunday zerikarli bo'lma; keling, biroz zavqlanamiz!
cards.uzDef: Kayfiyatni buzadigan, zerikarli odam.

cards.ex: It's important to stay true to yourself and your values.
cards.exUz: O'zingizga va qadriyatlaringizga sodiq qolish muhim.
cards.uzDef: O'z ideallari, qadriyatlari yoki shaxsiyatiga sodiq qolish.

cards.ex: He's a bit of a loose cannon, you never know what he'll do next.
cards.exUz: U biroz boshqarilmas, keyin nima qilishini hech qachon bilmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: O'z harakatlari bilan oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: Don't be afraid to speak your mind, even if it's unpopular.
cards.exUz: Fikringizni aytishdan qo'rqmang, hatto u mashhur bo'lmasa ham.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikringizni ochiq va to'g'ri aytish.

cards.ex: Our new manager is really on the ball; she's already made improvements.
cards.exUz: Bizning yangi menejerimiz juda epchil; u allaqachon yaxshilanishlar qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tez va samarali ishlaydigan, diqqatli odam.

cards.ex: The most important thing is to be true to yourself.
cards.exUz: Eng muhimi - o'zingga sodiq bo'lish.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizga, e'tiqodingizga va qadriyatlaringizga sodiq qolish.

cards.ex: She's a real ray of sunshine; she always makes me smile.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy quyosh nuridir; u doimo meni kuldiradi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma joyda xursandchilik tarqatadigan odam.

cards.ex: Her go-getter attitude is really inspiring.
cards.exUz: Uning intiluvchanligi haqiqatan ham ilhomlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun qat'iyat va energiya bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: It's time for you to stand on your own two feet.
cards.exUz: Sizning o'zingiz mustaqil bo'lish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: O'z hayotini boshqarishga, mustaqil bo'lishga qodir bo'lish.

cards.ex: He might seem gruff, but he's a rough diamond at heart.
cards.exUz: U qo'pol ko'rinishi mumkin, ammo yuragida u qo'pol olmos.
cards.uzDef: Tashqi ko'rinishi qo'pol, ammo ichida yaxshi xususiyatlarga ega odam.

cards.ex: She's known for being outspoken and not afraid to challenge authority.
cards.exUz: U ochiq gapirishi va hokimiyatga qarshi chiqishdan qo'rqmasligi bilan tanilgan.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini qo'rqmasdan aytadigan odam.

cards.ex: She showed incredible inner strength throughout her ordeal.
cards.exUz: U o'zining sinovlari davomida aql bovar qilmas ichki kuch ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga bardosh berishga yordam beradigan ichki kuch.

cards.ex: He had to face the music for his mistakes.
cards.exUz: U xatolari uchun javobgarlikka tortilishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri harakatlari uchun oqibatlarga duch kelish.

cards.ex: His moral compass always points him in the right direction.
cards.exUz: Uning axloqiy kompas doimo uni to'g'ri yo'nalishga yo'naltiradi.
cards.uzDef: Axloqiy qadriyatlari, nima to'g'ri va noto'g'ri ekanligini tushunish.

cards.ex: It's important to stand for something you believe in.
cards.exUz: Siz ishonadigan narsani qo'llab-quvvatlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga ishonish va uni himoya qilish.

cards.ex: You need to have your wits about you when dealing with him.
cards.exUz: U bilan muomala qilganda hushyor bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tez fikrlash va vaziyatga tez moslashish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: As a leader, you need to set a good example for your team.
cards.exUz: Lider sifatida siz o'z jamoangizga yaxshi namuna ko'rsatishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatti-harakatlari bilan boshqalarga yaxshi ta'sir ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: You'd have to have a heart of stone not to feel sorry for them.
cards.exUz: Ularga achinmaslik uchun tosh yuragingiz bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: His-tuyg'ulari yo'q, rahm-shafqatsiz odam.

cards.ex: He comes across as very confident, but he's actually quite shy.
cards.exUz: U juda ishonchli ko'rinadi, lekin aslida u juda uyatchan.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining qanday taassurot qoldirishi.

cards.ex: You need to face up to your responsibilities.
cards.exUz: Siz o'z mas'uliyatingizga qarshi turishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatni qabul qilish va unga yechim topishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She always goes out of her way to help people.
cards.exUz: U doimo odamlarga yordam berish uchun jon kuydiradi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalar uchun qo'shimcha harakat qilish.

cards.ex: It takes time to learn the ropes in a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishda ishlashni o'rganish uchun vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni qanday qilishni o'rganish, tajriba orttirish.

cards.ex: She's very self-assured and confident in her abilities.
cards.exUz: U o'ziga juda ishonadi va o'z qobiliyatlariga shubha qilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga ishonadigan va o'z qobiliyatlariga shubha qilmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: He really rose to the occasion and delivered a fantastic speech.
cards.exUz: U haqiqatan ham vaziyatga moslashdi va ajoyib nutq so'zladi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda muvaffaqiyatli harakat qilish.

cards.ex: You can trust him; he's a man of his word.
cards.exUz: Unga ishonishingiz mumkin; u so'zida turadigan odam.
cards.uzDef: O'z va'dasida turadigan, ishonchli odam.
